Whale currency afterall so depending on how much you buy and how desperate you are
Pooki Token & Sudden Raid Tickets are dependent on Account needs

Get Bai Long & Ryan to T6 minimally first. In the End Game, they can be bought as material for Mercure's Lab. Especially Ryan as he is an L+

Preference for Star Crystals or Essence will ultimately depend on your progression in terms of pets and gears. Unlocking all Pet Potentials first is bigger priority than refining gear substats

The essences are actually priced on the higher end here
Not frequent in acquisition so Top Picks are less. You may want to save for the 6* Legendary Accessory but the time taken for that can get you 3x 5* Legendary Accessory
While Nezha is really awesome, she also costs a lot and this can deprive you of other essential materials and resources especially in Early Game. But do get her to T6 at least
For the Equipment Boxes, they only give 1 piece of equipment
Amelia is more commonly used in Guild War even till late game as compared to Diaochan, who does require very high speed too

You likely will not have spare Pendants to buy anything besides the 7KOO Ticket/Selector. Ticket or Selector depends on whether there is any specific hero you want but difference in cost is 1-2 months additional wait
Essence of Memories is highly needed in large quantities to get Perfect gear. Aged Refining Dust is a material needed for a gamble
